style: A polished camera-ready scientific architecture diagram for a geoscience foundation-model paper, 16:9 landscape, 4K, pure white background, restrained Times New Roman typography, crisp vector-like shapes, realistic 2.5-D seismic and property cubes, thin precise arrows, generous alignment, no title, no watermark. Use navy blue for geostatistics, orange for the frozen foundation encoder, teal for the proposed neighborhood metric and ensemble, green for geological outputs, and light grey for validation. Prefer visual symbols, tensors, graphs and cubes over sentences. Every visible phrase must be short and correctly spelled.

pages.title: reconstruction_architecture_p21_v3
pages.description: Draw a single left-to-right framework with four numbered stages and one bottom evaluation rail. Stage 1 INPUTS has exactly two items: Sparse wells shown as labelled black samples {(s_i,z_i)}, and Registered 3-D seismic shown as one realistic seismic cube with inline, crossline and time axes. Stage 2 DUAL ENCODING has exactly two independent parallel modules: a blue Ordinary kriging module fed only by Sparse wells, showing a variogram curve and neighborhood weights; an orange Frozen OpenMind-MAE module fed only by Registered 3-D seismic, showing 3-D patches, patch embedding, four ResEncL blocks, a lock icon, a N x 96 feature tensor, Train-only standardization and PCA. Do not draw any connection from kriging to OpenMind-MAE and do not duplicate either input. Stage 3 FOUNDATION-INFORMED NEIGHBORHOOD is the largest region. It receives well coordinates and values, seismic attributes, and PCA latent features at one Metric builder. Beside it show five compact chips: normalized x-y, vertical x4, seismic weight s, latent weight 0.1, and 64-NN. Split into exactly three parallel graph-kernel branches labelled s=0, s=0.1, s=0.2. Each branch visually shows nearest-neighbor retrieval, a small 3-D neighborhood graph, inverse-distance d^-1.5, and k_s. Merge them with one Fixed mean node. Stage 4 FUSION AND OUTPUTS combines the blue kriging stream and teal fixed mean at one blend node labelled 0.25 OK + 0.75 kernel mean. Then show exactly three distinct output panels, each label printed exactly once: Porosity volume, Orthogonal slices, Directional variograms. The Porosity volume must be a colored 3-D scalar cube; Orthogonal slices must be three crossing property planes; Directional variograms must be a small directional diagnostic plot. Bottom evaluation rail has exactly five short items separated by vertical rules: Spatial 5-fold; 512 train/fold; 2,048 validation/fold; Frozen backbone; Historical-version transfer. The rail is visually separate from the forward path. Do not write equations beyond the short labels already specified; the paper body will provide exact mathematics. Do not use or mention LoRA, Adapter, residual, cross-attention, consistency gate, learned gate, random initialization, ablation, compact, baseline volume, performance values, blocked status or safety wording.
